ringconstruction.title: Ring Construction
ringconstruction.description: This final ability allows you to create a duplicate of your current ring at the cost of all your love. Once used, the ability becomes locked. Note: You must have Love Max lvl 3

first_tick_commands: execute as @s anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^3 run function final_lanterns:pinklanternconstruction
execute if entity @a[distance=0.1..8] run effect give @s minecraft:regeneration 3 0 true
execute at @e[type=!#final_lanterns:not_creatures,tag=!gl_user,tag=!gl_dead_minion,distance=..10] run particle minecraft:heart ~ ~2 ~ 0.3 0.3 0.3 0 3 force
